title: Review of c36's condensate food chain on fresh seed 4: replicated; predation clears prey (mean 175 vs 240) and boosts prey division (79 vs 7 persistent splits, generation 5 vs 1) before the predators die out at t~3700
summary: labkit re-runs of the claimed world (unchanged, 256^2, t=10000) and its predator-free twin (pred_on 0) on seed 4, scored with c36's analyze.py and splits.py. From smoothed noise, prey droplets and predator material form by t=400; dark predation clearings spread from t~900 to 3500, predators are last alive at t=3700 (median predator droplet life 800 t), and the prey emulsion refills the cleared space and settles by t~5000 (pack/sheet.png). Prey: mean 175 after t=2000 against 240 in the twin; labkit prey species 79 persistent splits, max generation 5, merge/split 0.30, against 7 and generation 1 in the twin; splits.py 80 prey divisions (7 with predator material within 6 px) against 7. The predator species has 0 persistent splits.

observations.S: pack/sheet.png t=0: smoothed noise over the whole domain
observations.I: pack/sheet.png t=400-10000: discrete prey droplets at bounded size; labkit prey species 156 persistent tracks
observations.D: pack/FACTS.md: prey 79 persistent splits, generation 5 (twin 7, generation 1); splits_s4.txt: 80 divisions, 73 not near predators
observations.X: pack/sheet.png t=900-3500: predation clearings; counts_s4.txt: prey mean 175 vs 240 in the twin after t=2000; predators extinct at t=3700

seeds_run.result: pass: prey 79 vs 7 persistent splits (generation 5 vs 1), prey mean 175 vs 240, predators extinct at t=3700

controls_run.X: pack_nopred: the matched predator-free twin, seed 4, same grid and duration

not_checked: splits.png strips were generated but I judged division from labkit counts and the sheet
verdicts.limitation: One epidemic, as the claim says: predators die out by t=3700 on this seed, so X is a transient consumption effect and the extra prey divisions are recovery into cleared, fuel-rich space; labkit's predator species reports up to 87-138 components in some frames of both runs (thresholding of a near-empty field), which I ignore.
